jobs.title: Deputy Production Manager
jobs.description: Job Description ACS Motion Control is looking for a Deputy Production Manager to support the Production Manager in the day-to-day management of the Production Department. The Deputy Production Manager will work closely with the Production Manager and assist in managing production activities, employees and operational matters on the production floor. The role includes hands-on involvement in production, employee management, problem-solving and supporting the achievement of production and quality targets. This is a hands-on management position for an experienced production professional with leadership experience in an electronics manufacturing environment who is looking to develop their management career. Primary Duties and Responsibilities Assist the Production Manager in the day-to-day management of the Production Department. Support the management and coordination of production employees and teams. Assist with assigning tasks and responsibilities according to production priorities. Support the implementation of production plans and help ensure production and delivery targets are met. Monitor daily production activities and assist in resolving operational issues on the production floor. Support employee management, including onboarding, training, guidance and ongoing feedback. Participate in interviews and the selection of production employees. Conduct employee feedback and performance discussions in coordination with the Production Manager. Support the Production Manager in addressing employee-related and performance issues. Ensure employees follow production procedures, quality standards, engineering instructions and safety requirements. Identify production issues, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities and work with the Production Manager to address them. Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Planning and other cross-functional teams to resolve production-related issues. Support the implementation of process changes and continuous improvement initiatives. Participate in continuous improvement activities such as 6S and Kaizen. Provide regular updates to the Production Manager regarding production activities, employee matters and operational issues. Act as the Production Manager's backup when required. Requirements At least 2 years of experience in a production leadership or management role. Experience in electronics manufacturing. Experience managing, guiding and supporting production employees. Experience conducting employee interviews, onboarding and employee feedback conversations. Experience training and mentoring employees. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Good problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Hands-on approach and willingness to work closely with employees on the production floor. Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work effectively under pressure. Good organizational and communication skills. Ability to work independently while working closely with the Production Manager and cross-functional teams. English – good written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: NPI Project Manager
jobs.description: Primary Function of Position: Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) processes, transitioning new products from development to production, while meeting quality, cost, and schedule targets. Roles and Responsibilities: · Manage and lead NPI projects from development through mass production · Coordinate cross-functional interfaces: Engineering, Manufacturing, ATE, Quality, Procurement, Logistics, and Marketing · Build project plans, track milestones, and manage risks · Manage subcontractors for NPI manufacturing · Lead end-to-end transfer processes from development to production (Transfer to Production) · Drive process improvements and implement work methodologies · Ensure compliance with quality and cost targets Job Requirements: · Practical Engineer (Technician) or Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Mechanical Engineering / Industrial Engineering / Electronics, etc.) · Proven experience in project management, preferably in a manufacturing or NPI environment · Understanding of manufacturing processes, especially electronic assemblies and enclosures · Ability to lead and manage cross-functional teams without direct authority · High level of English proficiency Required Skills: · System-level thinking and prioritization skills · Strong interpersonal and communication skills · Analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities

jobs.title: Senior IT Infrastructure & Systems Administrator
jobs.description: Reports to: IT & IS Manager Department: : IT & IS Position Summary We are looking for an experienced , hands-on IT professional to join the IT team, support and execute ACS's global IT infrastructure, ensuring secure, reliable, and efficient technology services across the organization. The role includes responsibility for IT infrastructure, Microsoft 365, cloud services, cybersecurity, business applications, end-user support, and participation in cross-functional IT and digital transformation projects. Primary Duties & Responsibilities · Execute and maintain the company's global IT infrastructure, servers, networks, cloud services, and Microsoft 365 environment. · Provide Tier 2/3 technical support to employees worldwide by responding to IT service requests, troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and system issues, and ensuring timely resolution. · Own and execute end-user IT service requests (tickets), including help desk operations and daily end-user support to ensure a smooth user experience. · Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including user account management, device provisioning, and access permissions. · Administer user accounts, endpoint devices, security policies, backups, and disaster recovery solutions. · Maintain and support business applications, including ERP, CRM, HR systems, and collaboration platforms. · Implement cybersecurity controls and monitor compliance with company security policies. · Lead or participate in IT infrastructure, cloud, automation, and digital transformation projects. · Work closely with external vendors and service providers. · Collaborate closely with the Senior IT Administrator , sharing knowledge, coordinating day-to-day operational activities, and providing mutual backup to ensure continuous IT support. · Prepare and maintain technical documentation, IT procedures, and system configurations. Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in IT infrastructure and systems administration. Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Active Directory, Azure , VMWare , networking, and virtualization. Experience administering and troubleshooting enterprise firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, or similar). Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, backup, disaster recovery, and endpoint management. Experience working with cloud services and IT automation tools. Basic knowledge of Linux server environments (Ubuntu, Red Hat, CentOS) – an advantage. Familiarity with network switches, structured cabling, server rooms, and physical IT infrastructure – an advantage Experience supporting ERP/CRM and other enterprise applications. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and project execution skills. Relevant academic background (Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field). Interpersonal Skills Service-oriented with excellent communication skills. Strong ownership and accountability. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Team player with a proactive and continuous improvement mindset. Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Curiosity and willingness to learn and adopt new technologies, including AI-enabled IT solutions.

jobs.title: ComponentE/Maritza Mechanical in Production
jobs.description: About Us ACS Motion Control is a leading global motion control company that develops and manufactures advanced motion control systems for a variety of industries around the world. We are looking for people with technical access, responsibility, and the ability to work accurately, who will join our production team. What does the role include? As part of the role, you will be part of the production process of advanced electronic systems, from the assembly stage to the finished product. Responsibilities include: software loading and configuration of electronic systems. Execution of final inspections of the products prior to their discharge to the customer. Mechanical assembly of electronic products and systems. Work in accordance with work instructions and quality procedures. Working with computerized systems and dedicated tools. Collaboration with production and quality teams. What are we looking for? Accuracy, order, and rigorous workability. Ability to work under load and multitask. Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team. Technical access and quick learning ability. Fine motor skills and good technical skills. Experience in mechanical assembly – a significant advantage. Correct additional requirements for overtime work according to production needs. If you like technical work, enjoy learning new systems and are looking to integrate into a leading technological company with a professional and stable work environment – we will be happy to get to know you!
jobs.description_original: קצת עלינו ACS Motion Control היא חברה גלובלית מובילה בתחום ה-Motion Control, המפתחת ומייצרת מערכות מתקדמות לבקרת תנועה עבור מגוון תעשיות ברחבי העולם. אנחנו מחפשים אנשים בעלי גישה טכנית, אחריות ויכולת עבודה מדויקת, שיצטרפו לצוות הייצור שלנו. מה כולל התפקיד? במסגרת התפקיד תהיו חלק מתהליך הייצור של מערכות אלקטרוניות מתקדמות, החל משלב ההרכבה ועד למוצר המוגמר. תחומי האחריות כוללים: טעינת תוכנות וקונפיגורציה של מערכות אלקטרוניות. ביצוע בדיקות סופיות למוצרים לפני שחרורם ללקוח. הרכבה מכאנית של מוצרים ומערכות אלקטרוניות. עבודה בהתאם להוראות עבודה ונהלי איכות. עבודה עם מערכות ממוחשבות וכלי עבודה ייעודיים. שיתוף פעולה עם צוותי הייצור והאיכות. מה אנחנו מחפשים? דיוק, סדר ויכולת עבודה קפדנית. יכולת עבודה תחת עומס ובריבוי משימות. יחסי אנוש מצוינים ויכולת עבודה בצוות. גישה טכנית ויכולת למידה מהירה. מוטוריקה עדינה ויכולות טכניות טובות. ניסיון בהרכבות מכאניות – יתרון משמעותי. דרישות נוספות נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות בהתאם לצורכי הייצור. אם אתם אוהבים עבודה טכנית, נהנים ללמוד מערכות חדשות ומחפשים להשתלב בחברה טכנולוגית מובילה עם סביבת עבודה מקצועית ויציבה – נשמח להכיר אתכם!
